service.description: Retrieves the hierarchical and relationship-linked discussion tree for a given component, artifact URI, or root discussion container.
Persists a message turn into the AgiMessage hierarchy.
Assembles instruction context from agi-ide, targetComponent, and discussion facets, invokes the AI engine, and records the assistant response.
Elevates an agreed topic/message milestone directly into a Mantle UDM WorkEffort.
Takes a decomposed plan payload and instantiates each phase as an individual child AgiMessage and AgiPayload in the discussion tree.
Recursively archives an AgiMessage turn or AgiDiscussion container and all its descendants by setting statusId to AmsArchived / AgdStatusArchived.
Soft-archives a specific list of spawned messages by messageIds or batchRunId.
Restores an archived turn and its ancestry/descendants back to AmsActive.
